name: MedOrbits Cloudflare Security Headers
managed_by: Cloudflare Dashboard - Rules - Transform Rules - Modify Response Header
description: Security response-header policy reference for MedOrbits. Review and deploy through Cloudflare after validating application compatibility.

notes: Confirm whether API and webhook responses require separate header policies.
Do not apply this policy to unrelated hostnames.
Review all subdomains before enabling HSTS.

X-Frame-Options.purpose: Restrict framing to the same origin.
X-Frame-Options.review: Check authentication, payment, and embedded application workflows.

Referrer-Policy.purpose: Limit referrer information sent to other origins.

Permissions-Policy.purpose: Disable browser capabilities not required by the application.
Permissions-Policy.review: Update if a legitimate feature requires camera, microphone, or location access.

requirements: Confirm HTTPS works on every hostname in scope.
Confirm certificate renewal and redirect configuration.
Review every subdomain before enabling includeSubDomains.
Do not submit the domain for preload without a separate review.

Content-Security-Policy.purpose: Reduce cross-site scripting and content injection risks.
Content-Security-Policy.initial_policy: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'; form-action 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests
deployment_notes: Inventory scripts, styles, fonts, images, APIs, payment providers, analytics, and embedded content.
Test a tailored Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only policy first.
Do not enable enforcement until browser reports and application workflows have been reviewed.

Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy.review: Test OAuth, payment redirects, popups, and third-party integrations before enabling.

Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy.review: Review cross-origin image, font, and resource delivery before enabling.

cloudflare_configuration.dashboard_location: Rules > Transform Rules > Modify Response Header
recommended_actions: Set the selected response headers to their approved values.
Scope each rule to the intended hostname and path.
Check origin response headers before adding duplicate values.
Keep API CORS configuration at the application or API layer.

notes: CORS is not a substitute for security response headers.
Do not use Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for credentialed requests.
Use appropriate private or no-store caching for sensitive and personalized responses.
Do not assume a security-header rule provides cache protection.

checks: Verify headers on the production hostname.
Check for duplicate or conflicting origin and edge headers.
Test login, registration, dashboards, forms, file uploads, and API requests.
Test payment, OAuth, analytics, and embedded integrations.
Review browser console errors and CSP reports before enforcement.

procedure: Record the existing Cloudflare rule configuration.
Disable the newly introduced rule if it causes application failures.
Document the rollback and the reason for it.
